boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's spi/ARM9/pm.c, 0x0205f5c0..0x0205ff70: 24 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. pret's pokediamond and pret's pmd-sky both carry this file as spi_pm.s under the same function names, and every function here is matched to one of theirs by its body: the PXI command it sends (0x60, 0x63, 0x65, 0x66), the utility command numbers (LED 1..3, backlight 4..9, power off 0xe), and the registers it touches.

Order: PMi_Lock is highest and PMi_SendLEDPatternCommand lowest, the same address order as pret's pokediamond and the reverse of pret's pmd-sky's. mwccarm emits deferred bodies in reverse, so PMi_Lock comes first in the source.

Older SDK: the functions pret has after the LED-pattern sender (PM_GetLEDPatternAsync, the sleep-callback lists) and PMi_WriteRegister/PMi_SetAmp are absent, and PM_GoSleepMode, PMi_SetLCDPower, PM_ForceToPowerOffAsync and PMi_WaitBusy are the shorter bodies of an SDK without them. PMi_CommonCallback is pokediamond's length (0xec); only its reply range differs (0x73 here, 0x74 in pret).
BOTTOM EDGE: TPi_TpCallback (0x0205f300..0x0205f5c0) is the highest function of tp.c (arm9/TP, src/engine/spi/TP.c).
TOP EDGE: CARD_UnlockBackup and the rest of card_common.c (arm9/CARD_Common) start at 0x0205ff70.
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/FS_Command: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.

PM_Init kept its name; the other 23 were renamed from their func_ names to the SDK names in this change (symbols/actor_renames.tsv records the evidence). The spellings are pret's pokediamond's (LED, LCD in capitals, as in the SDK headers); pret's pmd-sky writes Led and Lcd.

Text-only. The channel's .bss variables (0x020a8104..0x020a813c) stay with their owner unassigned. They carry pm.c's static names from ntrtwl/NitroSDK: PMi_IsInit, PMi_SyncFlag, PMi_SleepEndFlag, PMi_LCDCount, PMi_Work, PMi_Mutex and PMi_RegisterBuffer (data_020a813c is the buffer field of its last entry, which dsd records as its own reloc target).
